B. Conjugation
C. Specialized transduction
D. Transformation

To form recombinant DNA, scientists use various methods to combine DNA from different sources. Let's evaluate each option:

A. Translation - This is the process of creating proteins from mRNA, not forming recombinant DNA. So, this is not a way to form recombinant DNA.

B. Conjugation - This is a method of transferring DNA from one bacterium to another through direct cell-to-cell contact. It can be used to form recombinant DNA.

C. Specialized transduction - This is a method of transferring DNA from one bacterium to another through a virus that has been infected with the DNA. It can be used to form recombinant DNA.

D. Transformation - This is the process of taking up free DNA molecules from the environment and incorporating them into the host cell's genome. It can be used to form recombinant DNA.
